logline: Itinerant ex-military cop Jack Reacher drifts into American towns and systematically dismantles the criminal power structures he finds there, one adaptation of Lee Child's novels per season.

renewal.note: Season 4 confirmed October 2024 and currently in production (filming June-November 2025), adapting Lee Child's novel Gone Tomorrow. Season 5 also pre-announced.

bollymeter.basis: 92% on Rotten Tomatoes; critics credited showrunner Nick Santora with capturing the source material's laconic voice and Alan Ritchson's physical authority as a genuine casting coup.

seasons.review_body: Season 1 adapted Lee Child's Killing Floor and debuted to 92% critical approval. Reviewers noted that Santora's writing team captured the character's eccentricities, including the no-frills travel habits and obsessive roadside trivia, and that Ritchson's physicality addressed a persistent complaint about the Tom Cruise film adaptations. The show delivered pulpy procedural satisfaction without pretensions to prestige. Hollywood Reporter acknowledged it as more faithful to the source material than any prior adaptation.

bollymeter.basis: 98% on Rotten Tomatoes; the ensemble expansion around Reacher's former unit was widely cited as strengthening the show's emotional throughline.

seasons.review_body: Season 2 adapted Bad Luck and Trouble and launched December 2023 with weekly episodes through January 2024. Critics awarded it 98% on Rotten Tomatoes, nearly unanimous praise for deepening the show's emotional core through the 110th Special Investigations unit ensemble. The season is widely regarded as the strongest in the run.
seasons.season_over_season: Critical approval rose sharply from Season 1's 92% to 98%; the ensemble cast structure gave the season an emotional texture absent from the solo-Reacher model.

bollymeter.basis: 97% on Rotten Tomatoes; critics called it action-packed and relentlessly entertaining, though a slower mid-season burn drew comparisons to Season 2's tighter pacing.

pull_quotes.text: Season three is a thrilling joy ride, from the fight scenes to the spycraft to the relationship dynamics.

seasons.review_body: Season 3 adapted Persuader and broke Prime Video records with 54 million viewers. Critics awarded 97% on Rotten Tomatoes; the season debuted at 100% before settling. The consensus line: relentlessly entertaining and willing to lean into spycraft complexity while preserving Reacher's one-man-wrecking-crew identity. AV Club and some critics flagged a mid-season pacing dip where the dialogue circled familiar ground before the finale delivered the expected carnage. Collider noted the season perhaps lacked the heart of Seasons 1 and 2 while still being among Prime's best action product.
seasons.season_over_season: Marginally below Season 2's 98% at 97%; the mid-season pacing drew comparisons to the solo-Reacher model of Season 1 rather than Season 2's ensemble depth.
